title: BetterPPTX Deterministic Deck Spec v1
description: Agent-facing presentation specification for BetterPPTX. Normal authoring is semantic. visualReference mode lets the client AI author exact pixel frames for native PowerPoint reconstruction; BetterPPTX converts coordinates but never interprets the visual reference.

niceties.description: Explicit AI-selected native PowerPoint enhancements. A nicety may append or replace a native object, add a slide transition, and record an exact catalog selection. It works with semantic regions, AI-authored slide-inch rectangles, visual-reference pixel geometry, and HTML conversion. Omission means none; the engine never adds decorative niceties automatically.

powerpointNiceties.description: Compatibility alias for niceties. New authored specs should use niceties.

artDirection.description: Explicit AI-selected named World or bespoke inline World. Required for first-time-right certification; omitted legacy specs use a non-certifying compatibility fallback.

lang.description: BCP-47 language tag for native master text-style inheritance.

colorScheme.description: Optional explicit OOXML theme color scheme overrides. Omitted or null slots resolve from the selected World/default theme.

summaryZoom.description: One native Summary Zoom generated graph. Omission preserves it in patch mode, null removes only its owned generated section/slide/title/grid, and an object creates or atomically replaces it.

customShows.description: Named ordered slide sequences used by custom-show actions. Omission preserves the current collection, null restores the imported/default collection, and [] clears authored custom shows.

layouts.description: Optional custom slide sizes. Active layouts compile before slide creation. Omission preserves the current collection, null restores the imported/default collection, and [] clears authored custom layouts.

masters.description: Optional reusable slide masters. Masters compile before slide creation. Omission preserves the current collection, null restores the imported/default collection, and [] clears authored custom masters.

deliveryExperience.description: Author-declared playback acceptance contract. It never authorizes synthesis or charges. Use narrated-autoplay when the user explicitly requires a self-playing spoken presentation.

requireMotion.description: Require at least one authored object-motion beat in addition to transitions; technical presence is not playback or design-quality proof.

requireCaptions.description: Require authored WebVTT caption tracks for narrated slides.

masterPresetId.description: Selects one immutable bundled native slide-master resource. The selector is durable and cannot be reset or switched in place; use createNew or replaceDeck for a different resource.

themePresetId.description: Selects the semantic Office Theme carried by a compatible bundled template/master/layout resource. The selector is durable; use theme:null to restore that resource's theme baseline and createNew or replaceDeck to remove the selector.

presenter.description: Editable native 3D presenter across the deck. The AI must author exact rect/bbox slide-inch geometry, or pixelFrame in the visual-reference pixel route. Engine-owned presenter placement is deactivated. Distinct from talking-head video and live camera.

id.description: Stable presenter id referenced by motionTime.kineticSelection and slides[].presenterMotion.

model.description: Rigged multi-clip avatar handle (gen://rigged3d/…, model3d://…, or a GLB path).

identity.description: AI-owned editable visible-person choice when no personalized model is supplied. Choose joe, louise, pete, or the explicit research-only owner-gated Mena persona. auto is retained only as a legacy execution compatibility fallback and is not first-time-right-certification eligible; changing an explicit identity preserves choreography.

clipMap.description: Gesture intent -> 0-based glTF animId for THIS avatar: greet, point, enumerate, emphasize, contrast, ask, magnitude, talk, bow (legacy 'idle' accepted). A partial map is safe — unmapped intents fall back to the nearest beat's clip, then 0.

gestureDialect.description: Optional per-deck override of the world persona's dialect: { amplitude, tempo, energy, bias:{ intent -> intent } }. bias re-maps a gesture intent to make the presenter more/less assertive (e.g. { emphasize: 'talk' } to soften).

stageTreatment.description: AI-selected, unranked presenter staging treatment. The engine derives editable native geometry from the presenter frame; omission means none and no World may auto-select a treatment.

slideContinuities.description: AI-authored cross-slide identity, state, editable-item payload, ownership and narration handoffs. Each record binds adjacent slides; both slide narrations must declare the matching streamId and named cue IDs. A provisional 64-hex item digest can be submitted to dry-run: only when both compiled editable payloads match does a digest-mismatch finding return their computed versioned digest for a corrected assertion. No Morph, shared 3-D plane or silent state inference.

position.description: Normalized-stage [x,y] position; 0 is the left/top edge and 1 is the right/bottom edge.

dataDigest.description: SHA-256 assertion for the versioned effective editable payload; dry-run reports the computed value when equal endpoint content uses a different assertion.

position.description: Normalized-stage [x,y] position; 0 is the left/top edge and 1 is the right/bottom edge.
Normalized-stage [x,y] position; 0 is the left/top edge and 1 is the right/bottom edge.

dataDigest.description: SHA-256 assertion for the versioned effective editable payload; dry-run reports the computed value when equal endpoint content uses a different assertion.

position.description: Normalized-stage [x,y] position; 0 is the left/top edge and 1 is the right/bottom edge.

powerpointNicety.description: One AI-authored native enhancement targeted to a slide. Provide kind/name or a complete block to add native content; replaceSketch to replace an HTML sketch; transition for native slide motion; and selection/chartPresetId for exact choice provenance.

slideIndex.description: Zero-based target when no stable slide id is available.

kind.description: Native object kind such as chart-panel, table-panel, smartart, equation, model3d, media, ink, laser, shape, group, customGeometry, textBox, or image.

rect.description: Exact slide-inch rectangle in ai-authored-geometry-v1 mode.

presenterStaticPose.description: Stopped/edit-view posture sampled from an unchanged approved ordinary presenter. This does not change playback start time, motion speed, appearance, or placement. timeMs must lie inside the selected motion. Null restores the original safe opening pose; custom and rebuilt motion banks are unsupported.

motionId.description: Exact ordinary motion from which to sample the stopped pose.

timeMs.description: Sample time within that motion, in milliseconds; not a playback offset.

handshake.description: AI-authored brief for deterministic pre-commit factual consistency. A consistent handshake is necessary but never sufficient for first-time-right certification.

authoringMotionSelection.description: AI-owned exact semantic motion selection. The engine validates and executes; it does not rank or substitute motion IDs.

presenterMotion.description: Exact semantic motion selected by the AI for one slide; raw animId values are forbidden.

actorInstanceId.description: Optional author-owned native 3-D object identity for this slide; keep actor as the logical presenter ID.

frame.description: Optional performance-local initial frame in slide inches.

loop.description: False plays the selected motion once and holds its final pose until slide advance. True or omission repeats. Does not change motion duration, speed, or stopped/edit posture; allow enough slide time for the full motion.

narrationCue.description: Optional spoken phrase/word or {atPhrase|atWord|atMs} anchor for the selected presenter motion.

bbox.description: Export/inspection-only native geometry. Authoring Excellence Director specs must omit bbox/rect/x/y/w/h and let the engine place objects semantically.

pixelFrame.description: Source-pixel rectangle, valid only in visualReference ai-reconstructed-native/pixels mode. Top-level frames use the slide source viewport; native group children use their immediate parent frame. Ordinary objects require positive width and height; a line or connector may have one zero dimension.

x.description: Left offset in source pixels, never slide units or a percentage.

y.description: Top offset in source pixels, never slide units or a percentage.

presenterPixelFrame.description: Exact native presenter viewport in source pixels, valid only in visualReference ai-reconstructed-native/pixels mode. Deck placement uses visualReference.viewport; a slide override uses slides[].pixelViewport when supplied, otherwise the root viewport. The slide frame overrides the deck frame. This is not the visible body silhouette and does not change the approved safe idle opening pose, materials, motion cadence, camera, or playback time offset.

w.description: Native presenter viewport width in source pixels; must be positive.

h.description: Native presenter viewport height in source pixels; must be positive.

pixelPoint.description: One native vector command local to the required pixelFrame. Use x/y for a line endpoint, moveTo:true for a new subpath, close:true to close it, or curve for a cubic/quadratic endpoint. Endpoint and control coordinates are source pixels; they are not global slide positions.

x.description: Endpoint X in source pixels local to this object pixelFrame.

y.description: Endpoint Y in source pixels local to this object pixelFrame.

moveTo.description: Start a new subpath at x/y without drawing a segment; use true on the first point of each path.

close.description: With true, close the current subpath back to its start; x/y are unnecessary.

curve.description: Native cubic or quadratic curve ending at the parent command x/y. All control coordinates are local source pixels. Pixel arc radii are not supported by this route.

type.description: Cubic uses two control points; quadratic uses one.

x1.description: First control-point X in local source pixels.

y1.description: First control-point Y in local source pixels.

x2.description: Second cubic control-point X in local source pixels.

y2.description: Second cubic control-point Y in local source pixels.

pixelPoints.description: Ordered native path commands local to this object pixelFrame, in source pixels. Requires pixelFrame and explicit visualReference ai-reconstructed-native/pixels mode. Use pixelPoints for one command sequence or pixelPaths for multiple sequences.

pixelPaths.description: Multiple native path command sequences sharing the object pixelFrame. Each endpoint and control point is local source pixels, not a slide-global position. Start each sequence with moveTo:true and explicitly close closed contours. Requires the visualReference pixel route.

assetRef.description: Immutable opaque asset reference used by the matching content object.

sha256.description: Optional content hash for package-level media binding; content-addressed handles imply the same digest.

htmlConversion.description: Explicit secondary automatic HTML conversion. The primary and G6B-certifying route is visualReference AI reconstruction.

designAuthority.description: The AI authors visual design intent and trade-offs; the engine supplies the design grammar, proposals, validation, and safe realization.

engineRole.description: The engine exposes and executes capabilities, owns safe geometry/package mechanics, and verifies the AI's exact selections; it does not choose the design.

designRule.description: Human-readable statement of the AI-master design contract.

knowledgeAuthority.description: Use trained AI knowledge first; retrieve current or uncertain facts through public MCP discovery and readback.

ragPolicy.description: Human-readable retrieval rule for current, workspace-specific, or uncertain authoring facts.

geometryAuthority.description: All executable authoring routes preserve AI-authored geometry or convert AI-observed reference geometry; the engine never chooses composition geometry.

nativePreference.description: Use editable native PowerPoint objects whenever they can express the AI's intent. Custom construction requires a specific recorded reason.

completeness.description: Director completeness policy. complete is the default and prefers the richest meaningful World/capability treatment; balanced/minimal are explicit author exceptions. Downgrades are recorded in appliedDefaults.completeness.

textPolicy.description: Use shape only for geometry. Use textBox for standalone text and textShape for text inside a PowerPoint shape.

requires.description: Authoring requirements such as slide.id, content[].name, altText, notes, semantic layout intent, and validation gates.

selectionManifest.description: AI-authored resolved design choices. The engine binds these exact IDs to semantic objects and verifies them after save; it never chooses the variant on the AI's behalf.

briefDigest.description: Optional portable digest of the brief and explicit constraints used for this plan.

capabilityUsePlan.description: Portable, editable record of relevant capability choices. It records outcomes and presentation-specific reasons, never hidden chain-of-thought. Optional opportunities do not become requirements.

target.description: Stable content[].name or content[].objectName. Omit only for slide-level layout/transition choices.

coherenceReason.description: AI-authored rationale connecting the choice to story, audience, theme, and density.

customReason.description: Required for custom representation; explain specifically why native PowerPoint cannot express the intended result.

placeholderBinding.description: Canonical semantic placeholder binding. Semantic type aliases lower to native PresentationML tokens; legacy ph* aliases are accepted only when they agree. header/hdr is deliberately not authorable here because it repairs PowerPoint layout carriers; use headerFooter.header.

oneOf.description: Explicitly clear or suppress this binding.

inheritanceColorMap.description: PresentationML color-map state. Omit to preserve; null restores master mapping; an object replaces only the authored mapping.

placeholderVisualStyle.description: Sparse native placeholder style. Each null leaf restores that component to the next inheritance source.

slideNumberField.description: Native slide-number field. Omit to preserve, null to clear, or supply the closed field object to replace it.

headerFooterPolicy.description: Native header/footer visibility policy. Canonical and show* aliases must agree when both are supplied. Omit to preserve and null to reset.

placeholders.description: Omit to preserve; null restores inherited/source placeholders; [] authors an empty placeholder component.

background.description: Native slide background fill. Omit or set to null to reveal the inherited master/theme background; authored solid controls include colour and 0.001%-precision transparency.

placeholders.description: Omit to preserve; null restores inherited/source placeholders; [] authors an empty placeholder component.

preserveTimedSlides.description: Keep already-authored per-slide or measured narration advance times instead of replacing them with secondsPerSlide.

objectName.description: Unique explicit native object name, including a named editable group descendant. Ambiguous names are rejected. Kind/index/all selectors remain top-level.

scaleX.description: Grow/shrink width multiplier: 1 preserves width; null uses scalar scale or the native effect default.

scaleY.description: Grow/shrink height multiplier: 1 preserves height. Different axis factors also stretch text when the target contains text.

rotation.description: Spin angle in degrees. Zero is an explicit no-op; null restores the effect default.

templatePresetId.description: Canonical stable identity of the selected bundled native template resource.

avatar.description: Current-request selfie source for a talking head. Use {source:"uploaded",image:{data},consentAffirmed:true}; there is no default or persistent persona.

consent.description: Caller-attestation metadata for the current uploaded selfie. The client must obtain user permission before setting consentAffirmed:true.

bbox.description: Export/inspection-only; the avatar frame is engine-owned ellipse centered-cover.

rect.description: Export/inspection-only; the avatar frame is engine-owned ellipse centered-cover.

arrange.description: Semantic arrangement only; the engine computes final geometry. Use stack, weighted split columns, or a balanced 2–4 column grid.

regionPlan.description: Semantic named-region plan. Use split with an axis, names, optional positive weights, and an existing engine area; or alias a named region with {area, role}. Do not provide coordinates, rect, or bbox.

pixelViewport.description: Optional source-image width and height in pixels for this slide. Overrides visualReference.viewport for slide content and this slide presenter.pixelFrame, but not for an inherited deck presenter frame.

presenter.description: Per-slide deck-presenter overrides. rect/bbox are exact AI-authored slide-inch frames; pixelFrame requires the visualReference pixel route. Omitted fields inherit the deck presenter.

sectionZoom.description: Compatibility singular Section Zoom entry. Omission preserves in patch mode; null removes the singular authored entry.

sectionZooms.description: Ordered native Section Zoom entries addressed by stable object name and targetSectionId.

interactions.description: Semantic presenter beats. The compiler solves geometry/timing from empirical clipTimelines and records _synergyPlan; clients do not hand-author that plan.

scene.description: Semantic multi-presenter beats. Use motionId for exact AI-selected catalog motion; omit raw animation indexes.

notes.description: Native speaker notes. Null clears authored notes in sparse patch mode; omission preserves them.

transition.description: Native slide transition. Null removes the authored transition in sparse patch mode; omission preserves it.

layoutPresetId.description: Exact public native slide-layout selector. Null clears the explicit selector and binds the selected template default.

layoutName.description: Exact native slide-layout binding; when combined with layoutPresetId it must name the same layout.

masterName.description: Exact native slide-master binding; null/omission uses the selected layout master.

hidden.description: Native hidden-slide state. Null restores the visible default in sparse patch mode.

showMasterShapes.description: Native p:sld@showMasterSp state. Null restores the inherited/default true state.

showMasterBackground.description: Compatibility alias for showMasterShapes; both values must agree when supplied together.

showMasterPhAnim.description: Native p:sld@showMasterPhAnim state. Null restores the inherited/default true state.

target.description: Stable same-slide content objectName/name, including a named editable group descendant such as an animated-table row or cell; never an index or coordinate.

startMs.description: Absolute slide-clock start for the presenter clip. Solved contact/grab/drop timing is reported after this offset.

backgroundFill.description: Typed native slide-background carrier. This is additive and remains compatible with the existing public fill object model.

fillType.description: Catalog alias for type; aliases and canonical fields must agree if both are supplied.

percentRect.description: Native gradient/tile rectangle expressed as percentages of the fill frame.

fillSource.description: Opaque public asset source. Prefer an asset handle; do not place local filesystem paths in a public spec.

patternFill.description: Native pattern fill. The preset selects the hatch family; foreground/background remain independent colour controls.

texturePlacement.description: Extended native texture placement controls; values are independent and sparse-reeditable.

textureFill.description: Native picture/texture carrier. Source is opaque and placement/transparency are independently editable.

nativeShapeLine.description: Closed native ordinary/freeform shape stroke. Native linear gradient stops and caps are independent of the solid-only connector style contract. Gradient color/transparency belong on each stop; omitted angle is 0 degrees.

cap.description: Native stroke end cap for ordinary or freeform shapes. Omit to retain the normal default.

gradientDirection.description: Native linear stroke gradient; omitted means linear.

gradientAngle.description: Degrees: 0 fades left to right; 90 fades top to bottom.

imageAssetSource.description: Portable picture source. Public specs use inline image data, an opaque authorized asset reference, or HTTPS; local filesystem paths are compatibility-only fields outside this canonical carrier.

imageSizing.description: Semantic picture framing. The Director normally supplies the target box; x/y/w/h remain accepted for exported and compatibility specs.

picturePlaceholderBinding.description: Native placeholder binding for a picture. clipArt is a valid placeholder type here; it does not identify the picture asset.

pictureAdjuncts.description: Native picture-only adjuncts that are independent of the image source and crop.

pictureColor.description: Picture color endpoint: RGB/theme/preset color plus optional native color transforms.

imageAdjustments.description: Editable native Picture Format corrections, color mapping, transparency, and persistent artistic effect.

pictureStyle.description: Sparse native Picture Style override. Components may be null to reset only that family.

imageOptions.description: Canonical picture-authoring carrier. Top-level picture fields remain accepted as compatibility aliases, but new specs should place source, framing, adjuncts, adjustments, accessibility, and Picture Style here.

textFill.description: Editable glyph fill, independent of panel fill. null restores inherited/default text fill. Gradient transparency belongs to each stop; stops are ordered by position.

inline.description: Compatibility hint; softBreakBefore is the canonical same-paragraph break control.

source.description: Opaque authorized WAV asset handle, path, or inline audio/wav data.

url.description: Safe absolute URL. Arbitrary ppaction, file, script, and program targets are not part of the public contract.

effects.description: Native connector glow, shadow, reflection and soft-edge components. Null or an empty array clears all authored connector effects.

nativeGroupChild.description: An editable native group member with a distinct child contract: use local x/y/w/h in slide inches and style.fontSize/fill/line; do not copy top-level rect, options, shapeId, or fontSize into a child root. pixelFrame is local to the immediate parent only in visual-reference pixel mode. Image children require media provenance. Maximum nesting depth is 12. The public generate_from_spec tool schema supplies the closed field list.

motionId.description: Exact playback motion for an approved ordinary model with staticPose or its null reset. Playback begins at the original motion start, independent of the stopped pose.

animatedTableReveal.description: Native timing for an editable grouped-shape table. Null or enabled:false keeps the independently targetable composite static.

action.description: Object-level click/hover Action Settings. A direct endpoint is click shorthand; run hyperlinks remain text[].options.hyperlink.

targetSlideId.description: For kind:slideZoom, the durable semantic id of the destination slide. The compiler resolves the current native slide index after every reorder.

returnToParent.description: For kind:slideZoom, return to the source slide after the destination finishes. Null restores false.

transitionDur.description: For kind:slideZoom, transition duration in milliseconds. Null restores the native 1000ms default.

thumbnailDataUri.description: Optional PNG/JPEG Slide Zoom thumbnail. Null restores the refreshable neutral native placeholder.

bbox.description: Export/inspection-only local geometry. Null removes the local transform and restores placeholder inheritance.

rect.description: Export/inspection-only local geometry alias. Null removes the local transform and restores placeholder inheritance.

shapeName.description: PowerPoint preset shape name. Valid for shape and textShape blocks.

style.description: Sparse local style. Null removes the whole local style and restores the layout/master/theme source.

hyperlink.description: Compatibility whole-text hyperlink. Use text[].options.hyperlink for a linked run.

source.description: Compatibility alias for imageOptions.source, or a semantic equation source when kind is equation.

title.description: Accessibility title stored independently from visible chart/SmartArt titles.

mode.description: SmartArt representation mode. Native is the editable diagram default; shape is an explicit editable fallback.

decorative.description: Native screen-reader decorative state. true cannot be combined with non-null title or altText.

hiddenFromAccessibility.description: Compatibility alias for decorative; when both are present their values must agree.

reorderToIndex.description: Sparse-patch destination index in the slide's top-level object order.

cover.description: Opaque authorized poster handle or inline image data.

mediaCommandTiming.description: One owned native media command or an ordered command array. playFrom(seconds), togglePause, and stop are supported; null command is reserved for sparse update reset.

summary.description: Short semantic description of the structured object. It is preserved in readback and supplies accessibility text only when altText is omitted; it is not chart data.

closedCaptionTracks.description: Native WebVTT for a single narration clip. With multiple segments, put clip-local tracks on each segment instead.

segments.description: Ordered measured narration clips. Each clip may own WebVTT timestamps starting at its own audio time zero; slide-level WebVTT is rejected for multiple clips.

bbox.description: Export/inspection-only; narration has no client-authored placement.

rect.description: Export/inspection-only; narration has no client-authored placement.
